args.title: Document field limits for reports in the API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The Reports section lists the fields of `POST /reports` and the shape of `schedule`, but not their limits. Add a note (near the field list or the `schedule` line) stating: `name` is 1-120 characters, `categories` has at most 50 entries (each 1-60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` has 1-20 email addresses. These limits come from the zod schemas in src/api/reports.ts and apply to both POST and PATCH.

file: docs/API.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The limits are real and enforced by the zod schemas in src/api/reports.ts: `name` is 1-120 characters, `categories` allows at most 50 entries (each 1-60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` requires 1-20 email addresses. These apply to both POST and PATCH /reports and should be added to the Reports section of the API reference.
